interpretationPolicy: Only visually confirmed surface classes are recorded.
Pale runoff is not automatically gravel or sand.
Pit safety walls are distinct from retaining walls.
Photographs with unresolved geographic identity are excluded from geometry.
Ungeolocated observations do not generate a repeated perimeter pattern.
